verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents a `tofu import` command that finds an existing resource by ID and imports it into state at a given address (opentofu-docs-8, opentofu-docs-38). A community comment also references import blocks with for_each (opentofu-comm-12). Nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu generating matching configuration code for imported resources, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: documented configuration-code generation for imported resources, first-party docs on import blocks, independent hands-on corroboration of import workflows.
